title: Trump Says Xi 'Understands' His Taiwan Position After Summit
detail: President Trump stated after the US-China summit that Xi Jinping 'understands' his position on Taiwan — an ambiguous formulation that stops short of any specific commitment but signals the Taiwan question was directly addressed between the two leaders. The comment came after a three-day Washington summit that ended September 25 with no public decision on the paused $14 billion US arms package for Taiwan.
